from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u088/system/state/workspace/programs/task-57d7bde7.py')
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    q = (y + dy, x + dx)
                    if (0 <= q[0] < h and 0 <= q[1] < w and
                            q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]] == color):
                        seen.add(q)
                        stack.append(q)
            objects.append({'color': color, 'cells': cells})

    objects.sort(key=lambda obj: max(c for _, c in obj['cells']), reverse=True)
    occupied = set()
    moved = []
    for obj in objects:
        cells = obj['cells']
        shift = 0
        while True:
            next_cells = {(r, c + shift + 1) for r, c in cells}
            if any(c >= w for r, c in next_cells) or next_cells & occupied:
                break
            shift += 1
        final_cells = [(r, c + shift) for r, c in cells]
        occupied.update(final_cells)
        moved.append((obj['color'], final_cells))
    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for color, cells in moved:
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
